answer: Each name is charged a toll of 33 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The manifest lists a name once it holds Saddlebound stable clerk saddle seal, and a seal stable clerks renew after stable yard checks is the entry the clerk looks for. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The timber is on the docket. Every pulse is counted once. The onyx is checked, not assumed.
